result.reason: The operative language includes all preferred coverages and limits: CGL at $1M/$2M, E&O at $2M, cyber/privacy at $5M for processing Licensee data and Confidential Information, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates upon request. It preserves the representation-by-counsel provision. However, requiring every coverage to continue for one year after termination goes beyond the playbook and is particularly unnecessary or awkward for CGL and workers’ compensation, so the revision is not strictly minimal.
